name: Panic Princess
source:
Poor detective protects a lost girl by accident. But girl turns out to be a princess of the country. This encounter leads the detective to a trip of lust. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名穷困潦倒的侦探偶然保护了一个迷路的女孩，没想到她竟是某个国家的公主。这次邂逅，也令侦探踏上了一段充满情欲的旅程。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
